title: ECP Case Readiness Record (M3-CA1 v1)
description: Per-case registration-readiness record (M3-CA1 v1, 0.6.0): the 15-point mechanical check battery executed over the preserved qualification artifacts, the mechanical state, the set-class designation, the ground-truth validation track, the holding reasons (unresolved blocking owner items — explicit, never silent), and the four-state readiness decision (REGISTER / HOLD / REVISE / REJECT, precedence REJECT > REVISE > HOLD > REGISTER). record_hash = SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization of this document with record_hash removed; records are hash-chained per run (prev_readiness_hash). Real readiness material lives only in a private readiness area; public illustrations under examples/ must be format-illustration records with real recomputable hashes.

content_class.description: 'review' = real readiness material (private readiness area only); 'format-illustration' = public dummy (examples/ only).

set_class.description: Order §10 designation. PUBLIC is forbidden for evaluation-pool material while zero executions exist project-wide; HIDDEN/ROTATING require a set-binding reference; PROTECTED is the preregistered-evaluation-candidate default.

gt_validation_track.description: G0 architecture doc §4.7: determinate ground truths take the CONFIRMED track; INDETERMINATE (C-004-class) readings require the owner-authorized nondeterminate reading rule; the designed-ambiguity forwarded flag persists until that procedure runs — never silently converted.

holding_reasons.description: Explicit blocking reasons (unresolved owner items, owner-ruling findings). A case may only REGISTER when this list is empty.

carried_qualification_reason_codes.description: Reason codes recorded on the qualification artifact (may accompany ACCEPT as recorded, non-blocking findings — carried verbatim, never re-adjudicated here).

gt_correspondence_note.description: Present when the qualification artifact recorded Q3-CORRESPONDENCE-GAP: partial mechanical NL-formal correspondence (author-attested, declared limitation). Non-blocking at readiness; the O-04 GT validation stage must scrutinize GT defensibility against the natural-language presentation.

boundary.const: REGISTRATION READINESS ASSESSMENT ONLY — NOT A REGISTRATION (order §11/§12)

record_hash.description: SHA-256 over ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 of this document with record_hash removed.
